executive_summary.headline: Two decider matches on Day 3 determine the final playoff spots. Falcons and FURIA are already through.
executive_summary.key_insight: 9z already beat Aurora 2-0 at this event. The market still favors Aurora heavily for the rematch, but 9z have proven they can compete. This is the contrarian play of the tournament.
executive_summary.roster_note: Aurora underwent a major summer rebuild: new IGL kyxsan (from Falcons), new rifler Jimpphat (from MOUZ), new coach ash. The integration discount from Day 1 was real (13-1 on Nuke) but partially recovered Day 2 (2-0 vs NIP). The rebuild context supports fading Aurora in close matchups.
executive_summary.leaderboard_strategy: 9z are worth a contrarian look in the pick'em game. They are 7-point picks on Hotspawn (S-tier), and the market gives them ~28-37% win probability. If they win again, the upset value is enormous for leaderboard climbing.

day1_results.note: Huge upset. 9z dominated on Nuke (13-1) after a close Inferno. luchov posted 1.61 rating.
Expected Falcons win. m0NESY MVP with 1.62 rating. NIP pushed them to overtime on Ancient.
Both maps went deep. Legacy showed resilience.
Defending champions comfortable. Close maps but controlled.

day2_results.note: Aurora bounced back convincingly after Day 1 collapse. Wicadia dominated. NIP eliminated.
9z showed they compete at this level. Took Mirage 13-8, pushed both other maps to 9 rounds. Falcons through to playoffs.
BetBoom reverse-swept. Dominant on Anubis (13-4) and Mirage (13-7) after losing Ancient. PARIVISION eliminated.
FURIA reverse-swept. FalleN's 1v2 clutch on Mirage was the series moment. Legacy must now fight for playoff berth.

day3_matches.context: Winner advances to playoffs. Loser eliminated. 9z already beat Aurora 2-0 on Day 1.

probabilities.method: De-vigged from bookmaker odds (stavka.tv: Aurora 1.38, 9z 2.70). Cross-referenced with blast.tv community poll (83/17 split) and HLTV simulation.

day3_matches.pick_reasoning: Market strongly favors Aurora for the rematch. Despite the Day 1 upset, Aurora looked dominant Day 2 vs NIP (2-0, controlled). The roster rebuild with kyxsan/Jimpphat/ash is still integrating but showed recovery. Bookmaker lines give Aurora ~67-72%.

contrarian_analysis.contrarian_case: 9z already beat Aurora 2-0 at this event, including a 13-1 on Nuke. They took Mirage 13-8 off Falcons and pushed both other maps to 9 rounds against the tournament favorites. The Hotspawn pick'em awards 7 points for this S-tier match — if 9z win again, that is massive leaderboard value. The roster instability on Aurora's side (new IGL, new coach, international communication) is a structural problem that doesn't resolve in 48 hours.
contrarian_analysis.contrarian_risk: Picking 9z means going against a ~67% favorite. If Aurora win, you lose 7 points. The contrarian play is only worth it if you are trailing on the leaderboard and need differential picks.
contrarian_analysis.verdict: CONTRARIAN CANDIDATE — Take 9z if you need leaderboard separation. Otherwise, take the market line (Aurora) as the safer play.

day3_matches.context: Winner advances to playoffs. Loser eliminated. Legacy lost to FURIA Day 2 but beat BetBoom earlier in the group stage would be their second meeting.

probabilities.method: HLTV fan vote (Legacy 75.6%), egamersworld odds analysis, and tournament outright market triangulation. Legacy were pre-tournament favorites at 3.80 outright vs BetBoom at 12.00.

day3_matches.pick_reasoning: Legacy are significantly stronger on paper. arT is back from illness and the team showed resilience Day 1 (2-0 vs PARIVISION, both maps close). They pushed FURIA to three maps Day 2 and took Cache 13-10. BetBoom lost 0-2 to FURIA Day 1 and needed a reverse sweep vs eliminated PARIVISION Day 2. Legacy's firepower (latto, try, dumau) is superior.

contrarian_analysis.contrarian_case: BetBoom showed fight Day 2 by coming back from a map down to beat PARIVISION. zorte had 51 kills in the series. If Legacy have a letdown after the FURIA loss, BetBoom could steal a map.
contrarian_analysis.contrarian_risk: Very high risk. BetBoom were dominated by FURIA (0-2) and barely survived PARIVISION. Legacy are a tier above. The contrarian case is weak here.
contrarian_analysis.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED — Legacy are the correct pick. No leaderboard value in betting against them here.

contrarian_plays: 9z over Aurora (33% but 7pts, proven they can win)
leaderboard_plan.expected_value_note: Aurora and Legacy are the market-consensus picks. Most of the field will have them. If both win, you match the field. If 9z pull the upset again, picking 9z gives you massive separation on 7 points vs the field's 7 points for Aurora.

changes.note: Bench for 2+ months before joining. New to Aurora system.
Young talent, 3 years at MOUZ. Adapting to new team.

aurora.impact_assessment: Day 1 loss to 9z (13-1 on Nuke) showed integration issues. Day 2 vs NIP was better but against weak opposition. The new IGL + international roster creates communication overhead that doesn't resolve quickly. Coach ash acknowledged the difficulties in an August 2026 interview.
